metadata.title: NebulaCoop modding documentation
metadata.description: Make mods for NebulaCoop and Nebula: co-op calls and events, characters and colours, LumaScript, LumaKit, LumaCore services and LumaLink.

docs.searchEmpty: No results. Try a function, module, command or error code.
docs.previewText: These docs are for making mods. They come from Nebula’s docs, with a Co-op section for NebulaCoop. To install mods made by others,

hub.startIntro: Install LumaLink, then make, test and pack your first mod.

learn.heading: Learn
learn.intro: Understand how mods work, complete one task at a time, or build a complete mod step by step.

coop.heading: Co-op
coop.intro: Make mods for online rooms: see who is in the room, add characters and set players’ colours.

reference.heading: Reference
reference.intro: Look up the language, the library, the services, the command-line tool, mod files and the game's names.
